question: An engineer is configuring a vHBA template in UCS Manager. The engineer needs to specify the logical addresses used by the vHBA and the path through which the SAN traffic flows. Which two resources must be specified in the vHBA template? (Choose two.)
theory: A vHBA template needs two things to define how a virtual HBA connects into the SAN: a WWPN Pool, which supplies the logical Fibre Channel port address (WWPN) the vHBA will use to log into the fabric, and a Fabric ID, which selects which physical fabric (A or B) — and therefore which physical path — the vHBA's SAN traffic will traverse. MAC addresses and VLAN IDs are Ethernet/vNIC concerns, not FC, and WWNN is a separate node-level identity typically set elsewhere, so WWPN Pool and Fabric ID are the two vHBA-template-specific resources required. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Storage Management, vHBA Templates)
